text: Various methods for data protection have already been proposed such as the use of Homomorphic Encryption(HE), Secure Multi-Party Computation (SMPC), Differential Privacy (DP) or Federated Learning (FL) [9] [6][11] [7]. Using SMPC, the input data is simply masked or secret shared and distributed among differentparties. The computation is then performed collaboratively on the obscured data, thereby ensuring fullconfidentiality of the input. While each party is unable to access the input data, the output of the functioncan still be reconstructed by combining the resulting shares in the end.While SMPC is a very versatile and secure technology, its cryptographic nature requires the engineers who wantto use it to be highly educated about many different cryptographic concepts. Furthermore, there are a varietyof different SMPC algorithms, with changes in security models, protocol structures and most importantly,changes in the tradeoff between security and runtime. The suitability and performance of each protocolvariant depends on the concrete usage-scenario, which introduces further complexity. Widespread adoption ofsecure algorithms is prevented by these obstacles, potentially risking the loss of either the benefits providedby Generative AI algorithms or the patients’ data privacy.
